# StarRank

> StarRank is a public paid leaderboard at starrank.lol. Anyone can pay to place a URL or a social handle on the board. Rank is the total amount paid for a listing, highest first — amounts never decay, so the board shows what people have paid rather than a running balance.

## Primary Links

- [Board](https://starrank.lol/): the live leaderboard and the bid form.
- [Rules](https://starrank.lol/rules): the public ranking contract. Markdown: [rules.md](https://starrank.lol/rules.md).
- [Live stats](https://starrank.lol/stats): visitors, live volume, first place, recent settlements.
- [Stats JSON](https://starrank.lol/api/stats): the same figures as a JSON document.
- [Source](https://github.com/Sikyy/starrank): the implementation, MIT licensed.

## How ranking works

- Bids are Chinese yuan (CNY). Minimum ¥10, in ¥1 steps. Amounts are stored as integer cents.
- Amounts never decay. A listing stays on the board until it is refunded to zero.
- Rank is total paid amount, then whoever settled last, then a stable id. Paying more, more recently, ranks higher.
- Raising a listing costs the difference between the target and that listing's current amount, not its historical total.
- Only the visitor who first paid a listing can raise it, and only while it is still on the board.

## Page-one takeover

- A takeover locks the first page for three hours and sits in front of the ranked list rather than replacing it. Only one runs at a time.
- The price is a Dutch auction. It opens at four times current first place and slides down to 1.2× over 24 hours, then waits there until someone buys.
- A refunded takeover ends its lease early.

## Payments

- Hosted checkout via Waffo Pancake (CNY). Stripe Checkout is supported as a fallback; there is no product or price catalog — each bid is one ad-hoc line item.
- Opening or cancelling checkout never changes the board. Only a verified, idempotent paid webhook does.
- Refunds are absolute provider snapshots: a refund lowers the listing's total contribution by the refunded principal. A listing refunded to zero leaves the board and its identity becomes claimable again.

## About

StarRank runs on TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers, with D1 as the single authority for
listings, checkout intents, payments, and takeover leases. The product idea and board layout
take cues from outbid.lol; StarRank is a separate implementation. There is no revenue sharing,
no ad network, and no API key to obtain: the board is the product.
